why: The quoted line item's Epicor Cost Worksheet panel as the Bench Sugar with the customer's own field package stores it. The names, in order, are the r45 read (fixtures/rc108). What that read showed as a blank cell is written here as Sugar 26.1's Studio writes one: an empty array, not ''. Studio's save turns a row's filler into getLastFieldSpan()'s array() (or array('span' => N) after a field with a base span) and appends it through _addCell(); it never writes ''. rc108 drops only '' blanks, and the live read after rc108 settles which form that Sugar holds: 16 record cells for the eight values, 8 of them empty, the first row a blank cell before Material Cost. Sugar's record template draws a cell with no name as two record-cell divs (an outer filler-cell and an inner one), so 16 cells are the eight values plus 4 nameless entries that rc108 kept. With '' blanks rc108 leaves none (its own check T3), so its blanks are nameless arrays.
